title: Allow assistant transcript kind 30316 readable through the Bahia sidecar
observed_behavior: The default agentic assistant fails transcript replay with a relay rejection: event kind 30316 is not readable from the Bahia sidecar.
The sidecar read policy delegates readable-kind checks to internal/kinds.IsReadableKind.
Kind 30316 is defined as the assistant transcript kind in internal/domain/assistant.go but was not present in internal/kinds/kinds.go or IsCanonicalObservableKind.
intended_behavior: Assistant transcript events are service-authored canonical observable projections and are readable through scoped sidecar REQ subscriptions.
Readable transcript payloads remain AEAD-encrypted ciphertext; this change does not alter encryption or transcript-store decryption semantics.
Backend and frontend canonical kind constants remain in drift-checked parity.
out_of_scope: Changing assistant transcript encryption, storage, or replay implementation.
Redeploying the live Bahia edge stack.
